# Layout revision report — Riverside Park Plaza (60m x 40m, outdoor)

> This is a planning draft produced by an AI agent from simulation output. It is not a permit, fire-code or crowd-safety certification; a qualified reviewer must confirm it against the venue's actual conditions and applicable regulations.

## Summary

## Before / after

**Time the average visitor spent in crowded areas (≥ 2 p/m²): 3.53 s → 3.53 s (−0%)**; crowded person-seconds 706 → 706.

| Metric | Baseline (iteration 0) | Final (iteration 0) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Time the average visitor spent in crowded areas (≥ 2 p/m²)** | **3.53 s** | **3.53 s** | **±0 s (±0%)** |
| Crowded person-seconds (all visitors) | 706 person-s | 706 person-s | ±0 (±0%) |
| Peak crowded area (at one moment) | 12 m² | 12 m² | ±0 m² (±0%) |
| Worst hotspot, mean density over the run | 2.17 p/m² | 2.17 p/m² | ±0 p/m² (±0%) |
| p90 travel time | 122.9 s | 122.9 s | ±0 s (±0%) |
| Completed fraction | 100% | 100% | ±0 pt |
| Mean travel time | 89.2 s | 89.2 s | ±0 s (±0%) |
| Hotspots | 1 | 1 | ±0 |
| Validation errors | 0 | 0 | ±0 |
| Max density¹ | 2.21 p/m² | 2.21 p/m² | ±0 p/m² (±0%) |

¹ Highest density any single grid cell reached at any instant; a momentary peak, shown for reference only. The agent compares and stops on the crowded time per visitor above.

Target: ≤ 3 s per visitor in crowded areas with no validation errors. An iteration counts as better only if it cuts that by at least 10% vs the best so far and its completion stays within 5 pt of the baseline.

Identical conditions for every iteration: scenario `entry`, 200 agents, 300 s, seed 42, density grid 2 m, crowded = ≥ 2 p/m² (fingerprint `51f29b44`).

Stop reason: **no improvement** — crowded time 7.79 s/visitor (1559 person-s at ≥ 2 p/m²) vs best so far 3.53 s/visitor (-120.8% reduction < 10% required).

## Design brief (initial constraints)

Outdoor site: crowds spread less evenly than indoors and service access matters, so aisles are wider and every gate keeps a deeper clearance. K1 sells tickets, so it sits beside G-main, out of the walking line. Food trucks will draw queues; their placement is left to the solver and checked against the simulation before anything is moved. The fire lane is unbuildable and must stay continuous; the engine enforces it.

- min_aisle_width 3 → 3.5 m
- door_clearance 5 → 6 m
- K1 pinned at (18, 1) beside G-main

Booth coordinates were then computed by the layout solver under these constraints.

## What changed and why

No changes were applied to the baseline layout.

## Iteration history

| Iteration | Crowded s/visitor | Crowded person-s | Peak crowded area (m²) | p90 travel (s) | Completed | Max density (p/m²) | Errors | Comparable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 3.53 | 706 | 12 | 122.9 | 100% | 2.21 | 0 | yes |
| 1 | 7.79 | 1559 | 12 | 140.7 | 100% | 2.93 | 0 | yes |

## Assumptions

- Pedestrian metrics come from the **mock engine** (synthetic density field for demo purposes, not a pedestrian simulation); one scenario and seed per run, so results are a single sample, not a distribution.
- Booth popularity values are planning estimates of relative attraction, taken as given.
- A 2 m grid cell counts as crowded while its density is at or above 2 p/m²; crowded person-seconds add up the people standing in crowded cells, sampled once per second, and per visitor divides that by the visitors who entered. Max density is the single highest cell value at any instant; hotspot thresholds are the engine's. Travel times count finished agents only.
- Geometric checks cover booth/obstacle/door-clearance/aisle rules only; egress capacity, fire code and accessibility were not assessed.
- Analysis and revision proposals by `stub`; all metrics and coordinates in this report are computed by tools.

## Unconfirmed items

- Ground slope and drainage not shown on site plan (from floor plan)
- Power hookup locations for food trucks unconfirmed (from floor plan)
- Rain contingency (tent weights / wind limits) not specified (from floor plan)
- Results not yet re-run on the real engine (OR-Tools layout, Shapely validation, JuPedSim)

---
